definition: An automated logistics alert issued by Carrion Logistics when a delivery contract has been abandoned mid-route, signaling that the cargo — and sometimes the courier — is available for opportunistic acquisition. In underworld usage, it means someone has been declared open season.
origin: Corporate terminology from Carrion Logistics internal systems, co-opted by underworld fixers as threat language.
usage: Corporate dispatchers use it literally; street operators use it to mark a target who has lost their protection.
example: Word came down that Tessera had cut Yusuf loose — a carrion call before he even made it back to Old Harbor.
